method.input: Deterministic normalized request-summary JSONL, not native Claude/Codex transcript format. Each line contains ordered turn column values and model usage. ASCII synthetic fixture; production transcript parser, staging and session reconciliation are excluded.
method.pipeline: Read only bytes after a durable DB cursor in bounded 128 KiB chunks; JSON.parse complete request lines; prepared plain request/model INSERTs in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE/COMMIT transaction. Project/session INSERT OR IGNORE for each distinct key in the new chunk of input. Cursor and append facts/rollups commit atomically. New input ids strictly increase. Unchanged checks file size and one cursor row; no source body or prior request SELECT.
method.initial: Empty facts/daily tables. Initial facts+cursor INSERT commit timed separately from actual UsageRollupStore.read lazy materialization. initialTotal is the sum; checkpoint and verification between the two timings excluded. Schema construction, fixture generation/copy, prepared statement creation and validation excluded.
method.append: Experimental additive UPSERT of aggregateUsageSource filtered to new INTEGER PRIMARY KEY id range, using shared ROLLUP_STATES SUM/MIN/MAX and NULL-safe extrema. One and then 100 complete new requests append to existing session-0, with no old request application SELECT. Native SQLite UNIQUE/FK checks remain. Does not support changed old requests, duplicate natural keys appended at new offsets, file truncation/rotation or incomplete native events.
method.comparison: Only daily request/model WITHOUT ROWID differs. Both have identical columns, composite PRIMARY KEY/NOT NULL, four explicit date/project indexes, SQL, PRAGMAs and input bytes. Ordinary rowid introduces its intrinsic separate UNIQUE index for the same composite PK. Original facts and model tables remain unchanged.
method.sampling: Separate sequential child process per variant and pair. Excluded warmup pair(s), then AB/BA order alternating per pair. All stages are run once per worker; stats are across process samples. These are warm OS file-cache measurements, not cold I/O. No other benchmark process runs concurrently.
method.correctness: Full ordered fact/model/name/daily-state hashes after initial,+1,+100 match across A/B and all measured processes. Every measured process independently compares all provider/model x total/day/month/project/session groups against raw product SQL at all three states; both layouts get the same validation/cache workload. FK check every state, final integrity_check. Float hash canonicalization 10 significant digits; raw averages tolerance 1e-9. Statement execution instrumentation verifies zero standalone application SELECTs from turn_summary in ingest (aggregate INSERT SELECT source range reads are intentionally retained).
method.resources: dbstat occupied pages including both daily tables, four secondary indexes, intrinsic UNIQUE indexes and rollup metadata. No VACUUM after ingestion; real insertion growth. File/free pages separate. WAL length after pre-stage TRUNCATE is not total device I/O. Process RSS includes fixtures, validation and runtime.
method.excludes: No changes to product source/schema, no real account calls, no native transcript parser, crash injection, quota/IPC/UI, production read/write frequency model or generalized duplicate-log support.

SELECT provider,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      substr(NULLIF(local_day,''),1,length(local_day)-3) AS period, SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
      SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
      SUM(turn_count) AS turn_count,
      SUM(completed_turns) AS completed_turns,
      SUM(recorded_turns) AS recorded_turns,
      SUM(recorded_completed_turns) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      1.0 * SUM(c_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(c_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_output_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(c_duration_ms_known),0) AS avg_duration_ms,
      SUM(c_duration_ms_known) AS turns_with_duration,
      SUM(c_exact) AS exact_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_derived) AS derived_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_approximate) AS approximate_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_duration_missing) AS missing_duration_turns,
      SUM(unknown_time_turns) AS unknown_time_turns,
      SUM(stale_turns) AS stale_turns,
      MAX(last_successful_update) AS last_successful_update
        FROM (SELECT provider,project_key,session_id,local_day,input_tokens,output_tokens,total_tokens,turn_count,completed_turns,recorded_turns,recorded_completed_turns,cache_write_input_tokens,cache_write_input_tokens_known,cache_read_input_tokens,cache_read_input_tokens_known,c_input_tokens,c_output_tokens,c_total_tokens,c_cache_write_input_tokens,c_cache_write_input_tokens_known,c_cache_read_input_tokens,c_cache_read_input_tokens_known,c_duration_ms,c_duration_ms_known,c_exact,c_derived,c_approximate,c_duration_missing,r_input_tokens,r_output_tokens,r_total_tokens,r_cache_write_input_tokens,r_cache_write_input_tokens_known,r_cache_read_input_tokens,r_cache_read_input_tokens_known,r_duration_ms,r_duration_ms_known,r_exact,r_derived,r_approximate,r_duration_missing,unknown_time_turns,stale_turns,last_successful_update,min_started_at_ms FROM usage_request_daily AS turn_summary
    WHERE 1 = 1 AND ((local_day <> '') OR local_day = '')) AS turn_summary
        GROUP BY provider,period ORDER BY period IS NULL, provider,period LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

      CASE WHEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
      SUM(turn_count) AS turn_count,
      SUM(completed_turns) AS completed_turns,
      SUM(recorded_turns) AS recorded_turns,
      SUM(recorded_completed_turns) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      1.0 * SUM(c_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(c_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_output_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(c_duration_ms_known),0) AS avg_duration_ms,
      SUM(c_duration_ms_known) AS turns_with_duration,
      SUM(c_exact) AS exact_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_derived) AS derived_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_approximate) AS approximate_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_duration_missing) AS missing_duration_turns,
      SUM(unknown_time_turns) AS unknown_time_turns,
      SUM(stale_turns) AS stale_turns,
      MAX(last_successful_update) AS last_successful_update
        FROM (SELECT provider,project_key,session_id,local_day,input_tokens,output_tokens,total_tokens,turn_count,completed_turns,recorded_turns,recorded_completed_turns,cache_write_input_tokens,cache_write_input_tokens_known,cache_read_input_tokens,cache_read_input_tokens_known,c_input_tokens,c_output_tokens,c_total_tokens,c_cache_write_input_tokens,c_cache_write_input_tokens_known,c_cache_read_input_tokens,c_cache_read_input_tokens_known,c_duration_ms,c_duration_ms_known,c_exact,c_derived,c_approximate,c_duration_missing,r_input_tokens,r_output_tokens,r_total_tokens,r_cache_write_input_tokens,r_cache_write_input_tokens_known,r_cache_read_input_tokens,r_cache_read_input_tokens_known,r_duration_ms,r_duration_ms_known,r_exact,r_derived,r_approximate,r_duration_missing,unknown_time_turns,stale_turns,last_successful_update,min_started_at_ms FROM usage_request_daily AS turn_summary

      1.0 * SUM(c_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,

      SUM(recorded_completed_turns) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      1.0 * SUM(c_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(c_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_output_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(c_duration_ms_known),0) AS avg_duration_ms,
      SUM(c_duration_ms_known) AS turns_with_duration,
      SUM(c_exact) AS exact_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_derived) AS derived_duration_turns,

SELECT provider,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      substr(NULLIF(local_day,''),1,length(local_day)-3) AS period, SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
      SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
      SUM(turn_count) AS turn_count,
      SUM(completed_turns) AS completed_turns,
      SUM(recorded_turns) AS recorded_turns,

      1.0 * SUM(c_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(c_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_output_tokens,

      1.0 * SUM(c_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(c_duration_ms_known),0) AS avg_duration_ms,

      SUM(completed_turns) AS completed_turns,
      SUM(recorded_turns) AS recorded_turns,
      SUM(recorded_completed_turns) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      1.0 * SUM(c_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(c_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_output_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(c_duration_ms_known),0) AS avg_duration_ms,
      SUM(c_duration_ms_known) AS turns_with_duration,
      SUM(c_exact) AS exact_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_derived) AS derived_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_approximate) AS approximate_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_duration_missing) AS missing_duration_turns,
      SUM(unknown_time_turns) AS unknown_time_turns,
      SUM(stale_turns) AS stale_turns,
      MAX(last_successful_update) AS last_successful_update
        FROM (SELECT provider,project_key,session_id,local_day,input_tokens,output_tokens,total_tokens,turn_count,completed_turns,recorded_turns,recorded_completed_turns,cache_write_input_tokens,cache_write_input_tokens_known,cache_read_input_tokens,cache_read_input_tokens_known,c_input_tokens,c_output_tokens,c_total_tokens,c_cache_write_input_tokens,c_cache_write_input_tokens_known,c_cache_read_input_tokens,c_cache_read_input_tokens_known,c_duration_ms,c_duration_ms_known,c_exact,c_derived,c_approximate,c_duration_missing,r_input_tokens,r_output_tokens,r_total_tokens,r_cache_write_input_tokens,r_cache_write_input_tokens_known,r_cache_read_input_tokens,r_cache_read_input_tokens_known,r_duration_ms,r_duration_ms_known,r_exact,r_derived,r_approximate,r_duration_missing,unknown_time_turns,stale_turns,last_successful_update,min_started_at_ms FROM usage_request_daily AS turn_summary

      1.0 * SUM(c_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,

      SUM(recorded_completed_turns) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      1.0 * SUM(c_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(c_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_output_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(c_duration_ms_known),0) AS avg_duration_ms,
      SUM(c_duration_ms_known) AS turns_with_duration,
      SUM(c_exact) AS exact_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_derived) AS derived_duration_turns,

SELECT provider,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      substr(NULLIF(local_day,''),1,length(local_day)-3) AS period, SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
      SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
      SUM(turn_count) AS turn_count,
      SUM(completed_turns) AS completed_turns,
      SUM(recorded_turns) AS recorded_turns,

      SUM(recorded_completed_turns) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      1.0 * SUM(c_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(c_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_output_tokens,

      1.0 * SUM(c_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(c_duration_ms_known),0) AS avg_duration_ms,

      SUM(completed_turns) AS completed_turns,
      SUM(recorded_turns) AS recorded_turns,
      SUM(recorded_completed_turns) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      1.0 * SUM(c_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(c_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_output_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(c_duration_ms_known),0) AS avg_duration_ms,
      SUM(c_duration_ms_known) AS turns_with_duration,
      SUM(c_exact) AS exact_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_derived) AS derived_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_approximate) AS approximate_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_duration_missing) AS missing_duration_turns,
      SUM(unknown_time_turns) AS unknown_time_turns,
      SUM(stale_turns) AS stale_turns,
      MAX(last_successful_update) AS last_successful_update
        FROM (SELECT provider,project_key,session_id,local_day,input_tokens,output_tokens,total_tokens,turn_count,completed_turns,recorded_turns,recorded_completed_turns,cache_write_input_tokens,cache_write_input_tokens_known,cache_read_input_tokens,cache_read_input_tokens_known,c_input_tokens,c_output_tokens,c_total_tokens,c_cache_write_input_tokens,c_cache_write_input_tokens_known,c_cache_read_input_tokens,c_cache_read_input_tokens_known,c_duration_ms,c_duration_ms_known,c_exact,c_derived,c_approximate,c_duration_missing,r_input_tokens,r_output_tokens,r_total_tokens,r_cache_write_input_tokens,r_cache_write_input_tokens_known,r_cache_read_input_tokens,r_cache_read_input_tokens_known,r_duration_ms,r_duration_ms_known,r_exact,r_derived,r_approximate,r_duration_missing,unknown_time_turns,stale_turns,last_successful_update,min_started_at_ms FROM usage_request_daily AS turn_summary

      1.0 * SUM(c_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,

      SUM(recorded_completed_turns) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      1.0 * SUM(c_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(c_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_output_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(c_duration_ms_known),0) AS avg_duration_ms,
      SUM(c_duration_ms_known) AS turns_with_duration,
      SUM(c_exact) AS exact_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_derived) AS derived_duration_turns,

SELECT provider,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      substr(NULLIF(local_day,''),1,length(local_day)-3) AS period, SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
      SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
      SUM(turn_count) AS turn_count,
      SUM(completed_turns) AS completed_turns,
      SUM(recorded_turns) AS recorded_turns,

      1.0 * SUM(c_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(c_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_output_tokens,

      1.0 * SUM(c_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(c_duration_ms_known),0) AS avg_duration_ms,

      SUM(completed_turns) AS completed_turns,
      SUM(recorded_turns) AS recorded_turns,
      SUM(recorded_completed_turns) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      1.0 * SUM(c_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(c_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_output_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(c_duration_ms_known),0) AS avg_duration_ms,
      SUM(c_duration_ms_known) AS turns_with_duration,
      SUM(c_exact) AS exact_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_derived) AS derived_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_approximate) AS approximate_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_duration_missing) AS missing_duration_turns,
      SUM(unknown_time_turns) AS unknown_time_turns,
      SUM(stale_turns) AS stale_turns,
      MAX(last_successful_update) AS last_successful_update
        FROM (SELECT provider,project_key,session_id,local_day,input_tokens,output_tokens,total_tokens,turn_count,completed_turns,recorded_turns,recorded_completed_turns,cache_write_input_tokens,cache_write_input_tokens_known,cache_read_input_tokens,cache_read_input_tokens_known,c_input_tokens,c_output_tokens,c_total_tokens,c_cache_write_input_tokens,c_cache_write_input_tokens_known,c_cache_read_input_tokens,c_cache_read_input_tokens_known,c_duration_ms,c_duration_ms_known,c_exact,c_derived,c_approximate,c_duration_missing,r_input_tokens,r_output_tokens,r_total_tokens,r_cache_write_input_tokens,r_cache_write_input_tokens_known,r_cache_read_input_tokens,r_cache_read_input_tokens_known,r_duration_ms,r_duration_ms_known,r_exact,r_derived,r_approximate,r_duration_missing,unknown_time_turns,stale_turns,last_successful_update,min_started_at_ms FROM usage_request_daily AS turn_summary

      1.0 * SUM(c_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,

      SUM(recorded_completed_turns) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      1.0 * SUM(c_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(c_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) AS avg_output_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_write_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(c_cache_read_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(c_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(c_duration_ms_known),0) AS avg_duration_ms,
      SUM(c_duration_ms_known) AS turns_with_duration,
      SUM(c_exact) AS exact_duration_turns,
      SUM(c_derived) AS derived_duration_turns,
